units.source_text: 此按察大纳言是谁，古来有两说：

en.t: As for who this Azechi Dainagon was, there have long been two theories:

units.source_text: 一说是红梅右大臣，按察大纳言是他的旧官名；

en.t: One theory says that he was the Minister of the Right Kobai, and that Azechi Dainagon was his former official title;
Another theory says that he was someone else, not Kobai.
